arc.fallback: The Miasma of the Void, Vanilla Ice

description.fallback: Polnareff mourns for Iggy as he impales Vanilla Ice's forehead. Silver Chariot then grabs the other end of his sword and twists it, breaking Vanilla Ice's neck. Vanilla Ice lays on the floor, motionless.
